description: This file defines the Notification model class for the Opencart admin system, providing methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve, and count notifications in the database.
external_files: database connection and query methods (implied via $this->db)

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Model class for managing notifications within the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Creates a new notification record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific notification identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteNotification
methods.description: Deletes a notification record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getNotification
methods.description: Retrieves a notification record by ID.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notifications based on optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalNotifications
methods.description: Returns the total count of notifications matching optional filters.
